pages.text: Our Cauldrons aren't just for making brews! Sometimes you can make stew or some unguents to cover your body with for some effects!

To start making non-brews, instead of throwing a Henbane Flower, you throw in the good ol' Nightshade! Like Henbane, you get the seeds from breaking grass and ferns with the $(l:brewing/brewing_steps#boline)boline$(), and grow them on farmland!
This lotion will strengthened up your skin and bones when applied, making you take less damage from incoming attacks!
HAHAHAHAHA! Good ol' Flying Ointment! Makes you feel like you're actually flying and pumps you up! Works well with a broom hahaha!
Told ya you can stew outta this!
Some witches requires a more fancy get-up to make candles out of their cauldron, but out here, we just use a piece of string and get somehow get perfectly shaped wax cylinders out of it!
